profile.name: Alejandro Tejada
profile.title: Computer Science Engineer & Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: Exploring the intersection between technology, creativity, and human stories.

about.text1: Full-stack engineer with over six years of experience building scalable, user-focused web products. I combine a Computer Science background with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, AWS, and agile delivery. I was a Senior Software Engineer at PayPal (Xoom) through August 31, 2026; since then I focus on owned products and end-to-end freelance work.
about.text2: In LATAM e-commerce and retail — from marketplaces like Pacifiko to B2B catalogs with volume pricing, WhatsApp, and admin dashboards (Gloss and Glow, Aurelia Joyería, The Men's Formula) — I have shipped flows where the business runs inventory and sales without relying solely on a traditional checkout, working with international teams and strong clean-code, accessibility, and usability standards.
about.text3: Beyond engineering, I am passionate about science fiction literature, writing short stories, puzzles, and spending time with family. I believe technology is a contemporary form of art, capable of generating catharsis and transformation in people.

jobs.title: Freelance Full Stack Engineer
jobs.company: PopAuctioon, Aurelia Joyería, The Men's Formula & Uwii
jobs.description: Build end-to-end web and mobile products: architecture, implementation, and operations. Led AWS integration (IVS, Cognito, IAM) for PopAuctioon, a real-time luxury auction platform on Next.js, Supabase, and Stripe, with authentication, security, and live streaming built for global scale.
jobs.description2: Shipped lead-gen catalogs in Guatemala: Aurelia Joyería GT (B2C jewelry via WhatsApp) and The Men's Formula (barbershop wholesale with tiered pricing and an admin dashboard with RLS and internal costs hidden from the public). Excel → SQL + WebP image pipeline on Supabase Storage. Also contributed to Uwii with React Native.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer on Xoom’s web team, PayPal’s global digital remittances service. Contributed to the web applications ecosystem built with React, Next.js, Tailwind, JavaScript, Node.js, and AWS, improving scalability, performance, and user experience.
jobs.description2: Led modernization and visual consistency initiatives, owning internal apps for shared styles and components. Helped deliver the comprehensive update of Xoom.com’s header, footer, and main layout for a more cohesive, accessible experience for a global audience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Worked on web and mobile application development for the financial and medical sectors, using low-code tools like Mendix and Visualizer, as well as custom environments with JavaScript and React. Participated in digital banking and insurance projects, contributing to the design of accessible interfaces and efficient workflows.
jobs.description2: Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to define features, optimize performance, and improve user experience. This experience strengthened my skills in technical communication, UX/UI, and agile methodologies, preparing me to lead in complex and demanding environments.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: I was part of the development team at Pacifiko Guatemala, a growing e-commerce platform. I contributed to implementing features in inventory, finance, digital marketing, and user experience, working on both front-end and back-end.
jobs.description2: This experience allowed me to apply full-stack development best practices and gain a comprehensive view of the digital product lifecycle, in a dynamic environment that combined technology and business strategy.

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant
jobs.description: Served as a teaching assistant in courses including physics, statistics, mathematics, algorithms, and programming, supporting students in their learning process and understanding of logical and analytical fundamentals.
jobs.description2: During this period, I strengthened my ability to communicate technical concepts, foster curiosity, and adapt content to different levels, reinforcing my interest in teaching and training in STEM disciplines.

items.title: Aurelia Joyería GT
items.description: Online jewelry store for Guatemala: searchable catalog with filters and SEO (sitemap, Open Graph, JSON-LD), outlet, and product pages with WhatsApp CTAs (AUR-###### reference)—no payment gateway. Admin backoffice with Supabase Auth, product and image CRUD, taxonomy, contact inbox, and home content. Postgres with RLS, CSP and rate limiting, Sharp WebP uploads, graceful public query degradation, and Sentry in production.

items.title: The Men's Formula
items.description: B2B catalog for barbershops in Guatemala: public storefront with filters, product pages with unit and volume pricing (3+, 6+, case), and WhatsApp or contact-form inquiries—no cart or payment gateway. Admin dashboard with auth, allowlist, 2-hour session, product/brand/category CRUD, message inbox, and WhatsApp settings. Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage) with RLS and column grants to hide internal costs; Zod-validated Server Actions; Sharp/WebP uploads; Playwright and Vitest; Sentry and Vercel Analytics.
items.imageAlt: The Men's Formula B2B barber catalog for Guatemala

items.title: PopAuctioon
items.description: A real-time auction platform for luxury items, architected and developed from the ground up using Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, and AWS IVS. It includes advanced authentication with AWS Cognito, role management with AWS IAM, and live video streaming. The system was built to be secure, scalable, and ready for global growth.

items.title: Xoom.com Redesign
items.description: Major redesign of Xoom.com, a PayPal global remittances platform. I contributed to the modernization of the header, footer, and main layout using React, Next.js, and Tailwind. The update improved accessibility, performance, and design consistency across the entire site for millions of users worldwide.

items.title: Gloss and Glow
items.description: A modern beauty and makeup website featuring a dynamic catalog, integrated payment system, and an elegant, responsive design. Built with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
